reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering fishing equipment, tree seeds and products, prepared foods, fruit, minerals, and mayonnaise were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover gameplay effects, established cross-asset food and place names, crop timing, tree terminology, object gender, and glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Magnet_Name.preservationReason: Magnet is the standard Romanian noun with the same spelling as the English source.

Magnet_Description.source: Increases the chance of finding treasures when fishing. However, fish aren't crazy about the taste.
Magnet_Description.translation: Mărește șansa de a găsi comori la pescuit. Peștii însă nu se dau în vânt după gustul lui.

MagnetRing_Description.source: Increases your radius for collecting items.
MagnetRing_Description.translation: Mărește raza de colectare a obiectelor.

MahoganySeed_Description.source: This can be planted to grow a mahogany tree.
MahoganySeed_Description.translation: Poate fi plantată pentru a crește un arbore de mahon.

MakiRoll_Description.source: Fish and rice wrapped in seaweed.
MakiRoll_Description.translation: Pește și orez învelite în alge marine.

Malachite_Description.source: A popular ornamental stone, used in sculpture and to make green paint.
Malachite_Description.translation: O piatră ornamentală apreciată, folosită în sculptură și la fabricarea vopselei verzi.

Mango_Name.preservationReason: Mango is the standard Romanian fruit name with the same spelling as the English source.

Mango_Description.source: A big, sweet tropical fruit with a unique flavor.
Mango_Description.translation: Un fruct tropical mare și dulce, cu o aromă aparte.

MangoSapling_Description.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Mango tree. Bears fruit in the summer, or all year round when planted on Ginger Island.
MangoSapling_Description.translation: Are nevoie de 28 de zile pentru a deveni un arbore de mango matur. Rodește vara sau tot anul dacă este plantat pe Insula Ghimbirului.

MangoStickyRice_Description.source: Sweet mango and coconut transforms this rice into something very special.
MangoStickyRice_Description.translation: Mango dulce și nuca de cocos transformă acest orez în ceva cu totul deosebit.

MapleBar_Description.source: It's a sweet doughnut topped with a rich maple glaze.
MapleBar_Description.translation: O gogoașă dulce, acoperită cu o glazură bogată de arțar.

MapleSeed_Description.source: This can be planted to grow a maple tree.
MapleSeed_Description.translation: Poate fi plantată pentru a crește un arțar.

MapleSyrup_Description.source: A sweet syrup with a unique flavor.
MapleSyrup_Description.translation: Un sirop dulce, cu o aromă aparte.

Marble_Description.source: A very popular material for sculptures and construction.
Marble_Description.translation: Un material foarte apreciat pentru sculpturi și construcții.
